record.question: According to 2011 census Mizoram population density is
record.explanation: Answer B: 52 persons/sq.km. Mizoram's Census 2011 density was 52 persons per square kilometre. The government statistical abstract reproduces that state total; 42 is the 2001 figure, while 46 occurs for particular districts rather than the whole state. Reference: https://des.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2022/10/5ddf63c28bb0223c22fe291a605c5668/mizoram-statistical-abstract-2021-22082022-edited.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
